_comment: Magic items of the Dungeon Master's Guide (2024), PDF pages 217-338. Names, pages and classification only.

entries.name: Adamantine Weapon
entries.note: adapted: melee weapons only; adamantine ammunition is left out (arrows found after a fight are plain)

entries.name: Ammunition of Slaying
entries.note: rule 3: archery; section 6.10 names the Arrows of Slaying; judgement (magic ammunition is otherwise 23)

entries.name: Ammunition, +1, +2, or +3
entries.note: adapted: magic ammunition is spent once loosed, hit or miss (half of the plain kind is found after a fight)

entries.name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location
entries.note: A foe's divination spells cannot be aimed at the bearer and Detect Thoughts does not find them (no foe scries the party yet).

entries.name: Animated Shield
entries.note: judgement: an animated object, kin of the construct Animated Armor (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Armor of Vulnerability
entries.note: cursed; the curse is neither death nor undeath, so rule 5

entries.name: Arrow-Catching Shield
entries.note: judgement: it turns arrows aside but is no archer's item (otherwise 10)

entries.name: Baba Yaga's Dancing Broom
entries.note: rule 3: the fey (Baba Yaga is an archfey); judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Bag of Holding
entries.note: rule 3: dungeon utility beside the Portable Hole and the Bag of Devouring; judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Boots of False Tracks
entries.note: No tracking system: a band of people trailing the party reads a stranger's tracks and comes on carelessly (+5 to the party's chance of seeing them first).

entries.name: Candle of Invocation
entries.note: rule 4: candle; judgement (a Cleric's or Druid's candle could be 9 or 11)

entries.name: Cape of the Mountebank
entries.note: rule 3: confidence tricks (a mountebank is a charlatan); judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Cauldron of Rebirth
entries.note: judgement: druid (11) and warlock (6) both fit and neither more than the other

entries.name: Charlatan's Die
entries.note: rule 3: confidence tricks (a cheat's die); judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Cloak of the Bat
entries.note: rule 3: beasts (a bat's flight and shape); judgement (otherwise 19, darkness)

entries.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
entries.note: rule 3: swimming and breathing under water

entries.name: Crystal Ball
entries.note: rule 3: a diviner's scrying tool, a wizard's tool of the trade; judgement (otherwise 19 or 24)

entries.name: Cube of Summoning
entries.note: judgement: it summons six kinds of creature (aberration, beast, construct, dragon, elemental, fey), so no single theme

entries.name: Dancing Sword
entries.note: A sword more than 30 feet away as its bearer's turn begins comes straight back to the hand (the book: it falls to the ground); while it dances the bearer fights with what else they have.

entries.name: Defender
entries.note: How much of the bonus goes to the guard is the battle's judgement, made as the turn begins (the book: at the first attack): all of it when hurt and pressed, two against two foes, one against one, none with nobody near.

entries.name: Dimensional Shackles
entries.note: rule 3: planes (they stop teleportation and plane travel)

entries.name: Dwarven Thrower
entries.attunement: by a dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind
entries.note: rule 3: giants (it hits giants harder); judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Executioner's Axe
entries.note: The temporary hit points are the extra damage as rolled (before a resistance halves it); they replace smaller temporary hit points, as all do.

entries.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power
entries.note: rule 3: beasts (the figurines are animals), before rule 5's figurines

entries.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
entries.note: rule 3: disguise (it takes the look of ordinary clothes)

entries.name: Hag Eye
entries.note: rule 3: seeing what is hidden (See Invisibility, Darkvision)

entries.name: Hat of Many Spells
entries.note: rule 3: a wizard's tool of the trade

entries.name: Hat of Wizardry
entries.note: rule 3: a wizard's tool of the trade

entries.name: Heward's Handy Haversack
entries.note: rule 3: dungeon utility with the Bag of Holding; judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Horn of Blasting
entries.note: rule 3: war-horns and siege; judgement (it deals thunder damage: 16)

entries.name: Horn of Valhalla
entries.note: rule 3: berserkers (it calls Berserker spirits); judgement (a war-horn could be 25)

entries.name: Iron Flask
entries.note: rule 3: planes (it traps extraplanar creatures); judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Javelin of Lightning
entries.note: rule 3: elemental weapons; judgement (a weapon with a trick would be 4)

entries.name: Keoghtom's Ointment
entries.note: rule 4: a jar of single-use doses

entries.name: Luck Blade
entries.note: Luck rerolls a failed save or a missed blow in a fight (ability checks outside a fight are not rolled again); the +1 to saves works while it is in hand or bound; Wish from its charges is cast in a fight (Instant Health, with Wish's stress), as no item casts on the road.

entries.name: Lute of Thunderous Thumping
entries.note: rule 3: instruments (a lute that is a club for a Bard); judgement (otherwise 4)

entries.name: Moonblade
entries.attunement: by a creature of the weapon's choice

entries.name: Mystery Key
entries.note: rule 3: opening and closing (locks); judgement (otherwise 4 or 24)

entries.name: Necklace of Fireballs
entries.note: rule 4: its beads are used up one by one; judgement (otherwise 5 or 13)

entries.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
entries.attunement: by a cleric, druid, or paladin
entries.note: rule 3: holy; judgement (a cleric's item, otherwise 5 or 24)

entries.name: Nolzur's Marvelous Pigments
entries.note: rule 4: the pigments are used up

entries.name: Oil of Etherealness
entries.note: rule 3: the Ethereal Plane (before rule 4's oils)

entries.name: Potion of Poison
entries.note: adapted: it is a potion of healing with a secret until drunk or found out by Detect Poison and Disease; Identify, which in the game names only magic things, does not show it

entries.name: Quarterstaff of the Acrobat
entries.note: rule 3: performers (an acrobat's staff); judgement (otherwise 13 or 4)

entries.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
entries.note: rule 3: seeing what is hidden; judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Robe of Eyes
entries.note: rule 3: robes; judgement (its Truesight could be 19)

entries.name: Robe of the Archmagi
entries.attunement: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Rod of Lordly Might
entries.note: Buttons 1-3 and the mace are bonus-action abilities in a fight; the flaming blade's light is left out (its fire is in); the ladder is left out (no climbing system); the battering ram is +10 to forcing doors and the compass +5 to keeping bearings; Drain Life and Paralyze fire on a hit against a foe still strong (asked of the player only under the Reactions setting 'all').

entries.name: Rod of Security
entries.note: rule 3: planes (it carries you to a demiplane); judgement (otherwise 5)

entries.name: Ruby of the War Mage
entries.note: rule 3: a spellcaster's tool of the trade

entries.name: Scroll of Protection
entries.note: rule 4: single-use scroll that is not a spell scroll

entries.name: Scroll of Titan Summoning
entries.note: rule 4: single-use scroll; the titans are of every kind

entries.name: Shield of Missile Attraction
entries.note: cursed; the curse is neither death nor undeath, so rule 5

entries.name: Silvered Weapon
entries.note: adapted: works on any creature with the shapechanger trait; the world has none until the lycanthropes come

entries.name: Spell Scroll
entries.note: adapted: every level, read by its spell list with its own DC and attack, the check above your level, copying into a spellbook; a scroll stopped by a Counterspell is kept (as a slot is)

entries.name: Spirit Board
entries.note: rule 3: ghosts and the spirits of the dead; judgement (otherwise 24)

entries.name: Staff of Charming
entries.attunement: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Staff of Fire
entries.attunement: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Staff of Frost
entries.attunement: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Staff of Healing
entries.attunement: by a bard, cleric, or druid

entries.name: Staff of Power
entries.attunement: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Staff of Swarming Insects
entries.attunement: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Staff of the Magi
entries.attunement: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

entries.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
entries.note: rule 3: elements, before staffs; judgement (thunder could mean 16)

entries.name: Sword of Sharpness
entries.note: Objects are the things on a battlefield that can be broken (doors, barrels...); a creature's exhaustion from it lasts the fight (creatures keep no exhaustion between fights).

entries.name: Sword of Vengeance
entries.note: The spirit's hold works on blows only (its bearer may still cast spells at others); Banishment cannot be aimed at a thing, so the curse is lifted in the usual ways (Remove Curse, a temple), which leaves a +1 weapon with no other powers.

entries.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
entries.note: rule 3: evil, the undead; section 6.18 names it

entries.name: Thunderous Greatclub
entries.note: rule 3: giants (a giant's club, Strength 20, thunder)

entries.name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue
entries.note: rule 3: Vecna's lich-servant tome; judgement (a wizard's spellbook could be 5)

entries.name: Veteran's Cane
entries.note: As a cane it strikes as a club; the twist into a longsword and back is a bonus action in a fight (the Auto draws the sword at once).

entries.name: Vorpal Sword
entries.note: The DM's judgement written down: oozes, elementals, plants, swarms, amorphous or many-headed creatures and anything Gargantuan have no head to lose and take the 30 slashing damage instead.

entries.name: Wand of Conducting
entries.note: rule 3: performers (it conducts music), before wands

entries.name: Wand of Secrets
entries.note: rule 3: traps and secret doors; judgement (otherwise 5 or 19)

entries.name: Weapon of Warning
entries.note: Advantage on Initiative for the bearer and friends within 30 feet; the alarm wakes a sleeping camp when a band comes in the night (as the watch or the Alarm spell do).

entries.name: Whelm
entries.attunement: by a dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind

entries.name: Artifacts
entries.note: properties rolled per world on the four tables, as kernel traits and flags; quest, avatar and imprisoned slaad are rolled again (a person must set a quest; the creatures are not in the game yet); spell properties choose from the spells the game has; three flaws are words on the card only (no sense of smell, a changed face, plants withering at a touch): the game has no smell, faces or plants to touch

entries.name: Sentient Magic Items
entries.note: the purposes are noticed from what the game knows (victories, flight, parley, finds, reading, prayer, desecration, violence, rescues); a charmed bearer fights on Auto in battle while it lasts
